description: A dotenv file with CRLF line endings. Fails without the fix: VC011's value pattern ended in (.*)$, '.' does not match the trailing \r, so every line was skipped and the browser-exposed Stripe secret and OpenAI key got no VC011 finding; the entropy scanner's dotenv parser skipped the unquoted SESSION_SIGNING_SECRET the same way. The file must keep its CRLF endings.
